decision: Proposal only. Author no SVG until independent actual-reference review and root close A plus worth for this literal contract. No registry or native admission here.
purpose: One usable complete original editable six-area skirt design, rather than another study ledger. It completes Mara outfit design intentions alongside delivered cardigan and loafer sheets.
question: Can a smooth, ungathered waist and modest A-line fall be carried consistently into explicit rear shaping, side closure, inside band and hem/layering intent?

alternatives.choice: Quiet smooth waistband with left zip and hook
alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves Mara front concept and clean tee layering; requires original rear darts, inside facing and closure definition.

alternatives.choice: Shirred elastic waist and root gathers
alternatives.tradeoff: Closer to the visible COS example and avoids a tailored closure, but changes Mara waist character and adds visible gathering below the tee.

source_contract.literal_features: Plum narrow smooth band; clean centre front; two back darts and centre-back seam; concealed left-side zip and waistband hook; turned inside facing and labelled centre-back join; simple turned hem; shorter caramel cardigan hem and ivory tee waist overlap.
source_contract.ownership: Each XML element unique ID; full attributes, CSS, path coordinates, text, tail, parent, child order, ancestry, nearest view and feature, plus exact UTF-8 source retained in JSON. Independent unregistered artist views; not orthographic/body/pattern reconstruction.
source_contract.publisher: Review full literal stdlib XML parser first. One operation reads only local skirt.svg, caps 64KiB/250 elements/unique IDs/exact ordered six views, and writes design.json (512KiB cap) plus SOURCE-RECEIPT.json exclusively. No target imports, subprocess, network, geometry or renderer. First error stops with actual streams and partial outputs, no correction/replay.
source_contract.wrapper: Static title/caption/links and one external local SVG image at natural aspect, width 100 percent, maximum 1440. No JS/avatar/GPU/timers/resize.
source_contract.render: Only a separately reviewed root-only first whole browser image can qualify the appearance. No crop, retake, zoom, camera, layout or style rescue after first image.

stop: First incomplete or incoherent source B; one grouped pre-execution correction only if the critic proves an actual source defect with witness and two alternatives. Preserve any rejected version before correction. First registry error B without replay. No checklist or delivered appearance claim before both agents inspect the actual entire first rendered sheet.
preserved: 17 scoped checked / 10 broad open; full AAA/character/wardrobe/representation/expression/fit/motion/performance roadmap, accepted/default/original/frozen/unrelated work. Old MIDI mesh, source, viewer, resize, camera, lifecycle, capture and publication rescue closed. Review server and recovery retained; newer human check-in/pause wins. No push/publish/purchase/install/model/subscription/other-project work.
